articles.title: Phison shows an SSD design with an NPU and 64GB of memory that runs AI on the data it stores
articles.text:
Forward-looking: A lot of what AI servers do all day involves pulling data from their SSDs so a CPU or GPU can process it. Phison wants some of that processing to happen before the data ever leaves the drive. The controller maker has detailed an SSD design with its own NPU and 64GB of memory, designed to run PyTorch and llama.cpp directly on the drive.
The company showed off the design at Supercomputing 2026 (SC26) in Chicago this week. Rather than sending entire datasets to the host, the drive scans and processes data in parallel right where it sits. It then sends back only the results that matter. Phison claims this could cut data transfers by 10 to 100 times for suitable workloads. The host CPU would get some breathing room, too.
On paper, the drive's memory delivers 130 GB/s of bandwidth. That's more than four times the 28 GB/s that Phison's upcoming PCIe 6.0 controller can deliver to a host. In other words, the drive can read its own data far faster than it can transfer it to the server. The company also says developers won't need specialized programming tools because the drive supports familiar frameworks such as vLLM and OpenVINO.
Oddly, the only compute figure Phison shared for the NPU is 36,800 DMIPS. That's a decades-old CPU integer benchmark. As Tom's Hardware points out, the figure likely describes companion CPU cores on the drive rather than its AI processing power. There's no TOPS rating anywhere in the announcement.
The drive also has no product name or sampling date yet. Phison hasn't even said what type of memory it uses. In fact, the company says many of the products and features it showcased are still in development. For now, then, this is more of an architecture proposal than something a data center can actually order.
Drives that perform computations aren't new, either. Samsung put an FPGA on its SmartSSD back in 2018 and followed up with a second generation in 2022. But TechRadar reported last year that the drive had all but disappeared from Samsung's lineup. The outlet partly blamed the generative AI boom, which created much greater demand for raw storage capacity than for on-drive processing.
Samsung's drive also relied on software and IP that customers had to develop themselves. That makes Phison's promise to support the AI tools developers already use a significant difference. It could give the idea a better chance this time around, assuming the NPU turns out to be as capable as Phison claims.

articles.title: AI may not work like the human brain after all, scientists discover
articles.text:
AI may not work like the human brain after all, scientists discover
- Date:
- November 21, 2026
- Source:
- York University
- Summary:
- AI may not think like the human brain after all, according to a striking new discovery that challenges how scientists understand artificial intelligence. Researchers found that even AI models that closely predict brain activity may rely on internal processes the brain doesn't use, raising important questions about their reliability in neuroscience research.
- Share:
Artificial intelligence may be much less like the human brain than scientists have long assumed. A new study from York University has uncovered a surprising weakness in AI models that are widely used to understand how the brain processes visual information.
For years, researchers have relied on artificial neural networks (ANNs), computer systems designed to perform tasks such as recognizing objects in images, to investigate how vision works. Over the past decade, these models have become some of the leading tools for explaining the brain's visual system. Their ability to reproduce patterns of brain activity has made them especially valuable in neuroscience.
But the new findings raise an important question: Just because AI can successfully imitate certain responses in the brain, does that mean it actually processes visual information in the same way?
"Artificial intelligence systems are often described as 'brain-like' because they can predict activity in parts of the brain that help us recognize objects," says York University Assistant Professor Kohitij Kar, senior author of a new study. "Until now, scientists mostly tested this in one direction. They asked whether AI models can predict brain activity."
A New Test Reveals a Hidden Problem With Brain-Like AI
The York University team decided to approach this question from the opposite direction. Rather than simply measuring how well AI could predict the activity of brain cells, they investigated whether recorded brain activity could also predict what was happening inside the AI models.
If these systems truly operate like the brain, the researchers reasoned, the relationship should work in both directions. To investigate, they developed a method called reverse predictivity testing, which allowed them to evaluate similarities that conventional tests could overlook.
"Ultimately, we need computational models to truly understand the underlying neural mechanisms of how we recognize objects. How do we see objects move? While it's a very easy task that we do every day, computationally, though, it's a very challenging problem," says Kar, the Canada Research Chair in Visual Neuroscience and a member of York's Centre for Vision Research and Centre for Integrative and Applied Neuroscience.
The research team, which included York Postdoctoral Fellow Sabine Muzellec, a trainee with the university's Connected Minds program, examined responses to a wide variety of visual images.
Their tests included 1,320 natural photographs and realistic synthetic images featuring 10 familiar subjects: a bear, an elephant, a face, an apple, a car, a dog, a chair, a plane, a bird, and a zebra. These objects appeared against a variety of natural scenes and indoor or outdoor backgrounds. The researchers also introduced 300 additional images showing the same subjects in different visual styles, including outlines, drawings, simplified representations, and artistic interpretations.
AI Can Predict Brain Activity, but the Reverse Tells a Different Story
The results revealed a significant disconnect between artificial intelligence and biological vision.
AI models were generally successful at predicting the responses of recorded neurons, which are the specialized cells that transmit information throughout the brain. However, when the researchers reversed the process, those same neuronal responses were much less effective at predicting many of the models' internal features.
This difference was particularly revealing because the researchers did not observe the same problem when comparing neuronal activity across different brains.
"The results were striking. While AI models can predict the neurons we recorded in the brain fairly well, the brain cannot equally predict many of the model's internal features. Interestingly, this is not the case when neurons from one brain is compared against ones from another brain," says Kar.
The findings suggest that an AI system can produce results that closely resemble those of the brain while relying on very different internal mechanisms. In other words, matching the brain's responses does not necessarily mean that the underlying processes are the same.
Kar warns that this distinction could become increasingly important as artificial intelligence advances. If researchers continue refining models based only on how accurately they predict neural activity, differences between those models and actual primate brains could accumulate over time.
That would undermine one of the main reasons neuroscientists use these systems in the first place: to develop realistic explanations of how the brain works.
"The findings suggest that today's AI systems solve visual tasks partly using internal strategies that the brain may not use. Importantly, the parts of AI models that align with the brain are also better at predicting real human behavior," says Kar.
Why the Discovery Matters for Neuroscience and Human Behavior
The implications extend well beyond computer vision. Artificial intelligence is increasingly used to help researchers design experiments, study human behavior, and investigate neurological and psychological conditions. Many of these applications depend on the assumption that AI models process information in ways that resemble the human brain.
If that assumption is incorrect, researchers could draw misleading conclusions from models that appear accurate on the surface but operate differently underneath.
"Our findings challenge how similar current AI systems really are with the primate brain. We show that models that were previously thought to be brain-like rely on internal components that the brain does not appear to use. We provide a well-vetted diagnostic metric for the field," says Muzellec.
Developing AI systems that more faithfully reproduce brain function could eventually improve research into conditions ranging from post-traumatic stress disorder to autism. For now, however, the newly identified differences highlight the need for caution when using existing models to investigate human behavior or guide clinical research.
The concern may also apply to other areas of neuroscience. Similar artificial intelligence models are already being used to study hearing, language, and movement. If those systems also rely on internal processes that differ from biological ones, researchers may need to reconsider how much they can reveal about the nervous system.
Building AI That More Closely Matches the Human Brain
Rather than suggesting that artificial neural networks should be abandoned, the findings provide a way to make them more useful and scientifically reliable.
By identifying which features of an AI model correspond to real neural activity, researchers can focus on developing systems that more accurately reflect the biological mechanisms behind perception.
"Our approach helps identify which parts of an ANN truly match brain activity, allowing us to build more reliable models for understanding how people see and interpret the world," says Kar. "This is especially important for our autism research program, which builds on models of the neurotypical brain as a baseline."
A neurotypical brain refers to one with patterns of neurological development and functioning generally considered typical. Establishing accurate models of these patterns is important for researchers investigating how perception and information processing may differ in conditions such as autism.
To help other scientists put their findings into practice, the team has released a publicly available testing toolkit that AI developers can use to evaluate their own models and identify opportunities for improvement.
Published in Nature Machine Intelligence, the study introduces a new approach to evaluating artificial intelligence that goes beyond measuring how well a system performs a task. The researchers argue that understanding whether AI reaches its results through processes that genuinely resemble those of the brain is just as important.
The discovery could help guide the development of a new generation of AI models that not only recognize the world with impressive accuracy, but also offer a more faithful picture of how the human brain makes sense of what it sees.
Story Source:
Materials provided by York University. Original written by Sandra McLean. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
Journal Reference:
- Sabine Muzellec, Kohitij Kar. Reverse predictivity for bidirectional comparison of neural networks and biological brains. Nature Machine Intelligence, 2026; 8 (3): 474 DOI: 10.1038/s42256-026-01204-0

articles.title: BepiColombo faz manobra decisiva para entrar na órbita de Mercúrio
articles.text:
A missão BepiColombo acionou quatro propulsores nesta sexta-feira (21) para realizar uma manobra decisiva de inserção orbital em Mercúrio. A operação, conduzida pela espaçonave Mercury Planetary Orbiter (MPO), da Agência Espacial Europeia (ESA), começou às 15h24 (horário de Brasília) e teve duração prevista de 37 minutos.
O procedimento tem como objetivo reduzir a velocidade da espaçonave em relação ao planeta e permitir que a gravidade de Mercúrio capture os dois orbitadores da missão. Após o acionamento dos propulsores, a equipe informou que aguardava a reorientação da nave e o restabelecimento da comunicação com a Terra para acompanhar o resultado da operação.
As our spacecraft nears Mercury, thrusters are expected to be firing now, and for the next 37 minutes. https://t.co/z7hRbhYTqp
— BepiColombo (@BepiColombo) November 21, 2026
BepiColombo aguarda confirmação da manobra
Em publicações na rede social X, a equipe da BepiColombo informou que os quatro propulsores estavam em funcionamento durante a aproximação de Mercúrio. Cerca de uma hora depois, a missão comunicou que a queima havia terminado ou deveria estar concluída naquele momento.
A equipe explicou que a espaçonave precisaria mudar sua orientação antes de voltar a se comunicar com a Terra. A aquisição do sinal estava prevista para as 21h37 UTC (18h37 no horário de Brasília), algumas horas após o término da operação.
The thrusters are expected to have have finished firing around 30 minutes ago. Now we must be patient and wait. The spacecraft will reorient itself and communicate with us again in a couple of hours. Acquisition of signal is expected at 21:37 UTC / 22:37 CET.
— BepiColombo (@BepiColombo) November 21, 2026
Até a última atualização divulgada nas publicações, a equipe ainda aguardava o restabelecimento do contato. Por isso, a confirmação do sucesso da inserção orbital dependia do recebimento e da análise dos dados da espaçonave.
Missão europeia e japonesa está em viagem desde 2018
A BepiColombo é uma missão conjunta da ESA e da Agência Japonesa de Exploração Aeroespacial (JAXA). Ela é formada por dois orbitadores principais: o Mercury Planetary Orbiter (MPO), europeu, e o Mercury Magnetospheric Orbiter (MMO), japonês, também conhecido como Mio.
As espaçonaves partiram da Terra em outubro de 2018, a bordo de um foguete Ariane 5 lançado da Guiana Francesa. A viagem pelo Sistema Solar interno incluiu uma passagem pela Terra, duas por Vênus e seis por Mercúrio.
A chegada ao planeta começou em 3 de setembro, quando o módulo de transferência Mercury Transfer Module (MTM) liberou os dois orbitadores. Apesar da separação do módulo, MPO e Mio ainda permanecem conectados e têm separação prevista para 9 de dezembro, aproximadamente.
Depois disso, cada espaçonave seguirá para sua órbita definitiva. A Mio deverá percorrer uma trajetória bastante elíptica, passando sobre os polos de Mercúrio. Já a MPO também ficará em uma órbita polar, mas com uma trajetória menos elíptica. A sonda europeia ainda precisará realizar outras manobras com seus motores, com chegada à órbita final prevista para 10 de março de 2027.
As atividades científicas da missão estão programadas para começar em 6 de abril de 2027. Os dois orbitadores deverão coletar informações complementares sobre Mercúrio a partir de diferentes posições.
Entre os objetivos estão investigar a estrutura e a dinâmica da magnetosfera do planeta, sua interação com o vento solar, a composição interna e seu grande núcleo de ferro, além da origem de seu campo magnético.
Ana Figueiredo é editora de tecnologia do Olhar Digital. É formada em Jornalismo pela Universidade Federal de Uberlândia (UFU).

articles.title: Les Anneaux de pouvoir saison 3 : les petits secrets du générique, qui délaisse les énigmes cachées
articles.text:
Qu’il est loin le temps où les génériques des séries télévisées étaient sans style graphique, en faisant défiler le casting à l’écran avec chaque nom en surimpression. Désormais, les openings ont beaucoup plus d’allure, avec un vrai soin apporté à la direction artistique. Ce sont des clips réussis, un peu à l’image des séquences d’ouverture de James Bond.
En la matière, le générique de la série Les Anneaux de pouvoir (Rings of power) se hisse clairement parmi les meilleurs. Une partie de la réussite de ce clip tient à la technique employée : il s’agit de cymatique, un procédé qui sert à visualiser les vibrations acoustiques. En clair, on rend le son visible en passant par un matériau qui sert d’interface.
En pratique, la cymatique passe surtout par du sable ou une fine poudre que l’on répand sur une plaque. Il suffit de la faire vibrer à une fréquence précise ; les grains se regroupent alors dans les zones qui ne bougent pas et dessinent des motifs symétriques. Les génériques des Anneaux de pouvoir reposent sur ce principe.
C’est très bien vu. Le studio qui a créé ce générique, Plains of Yonder, fait ainsi référence aux Ainur de Tolkien. Dans Le Silmarillion, œuvre qui est en quelque sorte l’équivalent de la Genèse pour Le Seigneur des anneaux, ces êtres divins créent le monde en jouant de la musique. Jusqu’à ce que Melkor, aka Morgoth, insère ses notes discordantes…
Un opening plus sombre, à l’image de la saison
Ce procédé a été repris dans le générique de la saison 2 puis dans celui de la saison 3, qui apparaît à partir de l’épisode 2. Les quatre premiers épisodes de la saison sont tous sortis le 11 novembre sur Prime Video. Bien sûr, ces openings ont évolué au fil du temps. Cette fois, les grains de sable dorés que l’on voyait dans les deux premières saisons sont devenus plus sombres, mais forment toujours des motifs mouvants.
Dans ces motifs mouvants, des spectateurs croient reconnaître des paysages ou des lieux précis. Sur Reddit, dans le forum r/LOTR_on_Prime, des fans se demandent déjà ce que représentent ces images. D’aucuns pensent avoir vu la tour de Barad-dûr, la forteresse de Sauron au Mordor. D’autres disent avoir décelé la chute de Númenor.
Hélas, ceux qui comptaient y trouver des indices sur la suite de l’intrigue vont être déçus : cette fois, les créateurs ont choisi de ne plus renvoyer aux événements de la saison. Patrick McKay, l’un des deux showrunners de la série, l’a expliqué au site américain SlashFilm dans une interview publiée le 11 novembre.
Plains of Yonder est venu le voir avec l’envie de tout refaire. D’après McKay, les graphistes du studio voulaient que la séquence traduise ce que la saison fait ressentir, au lieu de renvoyer à ce qui s’y passe. Il la décrit comme « un peu plus dramatique », avec davantage de noirceur. Le générique s’assombrit donc avec la série.
La saison 3 se déroule cinq ans après la deuxième, en pleine guerre entre les Elfes et Sauron, pendant que le seigneur des ténèbres cherche à forger l’Anneau unique.
Le règne de Sauron en millions de particules
Plains of Yonder est le studio de Katrina Crawford et Mark Bashore. Sur la page consacrée au projet, il a baptisé la séquence « Cataclysmal Splendor », à peu près « splendeur cataclysmique ». Le studio dit avoir voulu montrer le règne de Sauron par l’énergie, le son et la terre, avec une force malveillante qui remonte à la surface.
Pour la fabriquer, l’équipe a mélangé trois techniques. D’abord, de grands paysages faits de particules en 3D. Ensuite, des formations physiques construites à partir de millions de particules. Enfin, des matières terreuses filmées à très haute vitesse, ce qui permet de ralentir à l’écran un mouvement qui dure une fraction de seconde.
La 3D est l’œuvre du studio MakMac, et les prises de vues réelles ont été tournées avec le studio Ms. Robot. Plains of Yonder a mis plusieurs extraits animés de la séquence en ligne sur son site, et le générique circule aussi sur Instagram.
Toujours la musique des Ainur, mais sans énigmes
En 2022, les motifs étaient remplis de clins d’œil. Les fans avaient vite repéré des symboles cachés dans le générique, puis le studio avait lui-même dévoilé les secrets de la séquence. Katrina Crawford expliquait alors à Variety avoir placé des anneaux par groupes de neuf pour les Hommes, de sept pour les Nains et de trois pour les Elfes, plus un anneau seul.
En revanche, la musique du générique n’a pas changé : c’est toujours le thème signé Howard Shore, le compositeur de la trilogie de Peter Jackson. Plains of Yonder a aussi signé le générique de The White Lotus sur HBO, avec ses papiers peints aux motifs de plus en plus inquiétants. SlashFilm y voit un procédé proche. Les épisodes 5 et 6 sortent ce mercredi 18 novembre sur Prime Video, et les deux derniers, les épisodes 7 et 8, le mercredi 25 novembre.

articles.title: Décodeur, écrans en plus, bouquets : Canal+ annonce une série de hausses pour 2027
articles.text:
L’abonnement principal n’est pas concerné, mais la facture risque bien d’augmenter pour de nombreux abonnés Canal+. Depuis le 17 novembre, le groupe envoie un e-mail annonçant de nouveaux tarifs pour plusieurs options facturées en supplément, comme l’a d’abord relevé Anaël sur X. Nous l’avons nous aussi reçu : « Le montant mensuel de vos frais de location du décodeur CANAL+ sera de 8 € à compter de votre mensualité de janvier 2027 », écrit Canal+, contre 7 euros aujourd’hui. Une hausse de 12 euros par an, que le groupe justifie par la volonté de « poursuivre nos investissements pour vous offrir une expérience de divertissement toujours plus fluide et adaptée à vos usages ». Les promotions en cours sur ces frais de location restent valables jusqu’à leur date de fin, précise le message.
 🟠 À compter du 1er janvier, @canalplus augmente certains de ses tarifs : la location du Décodeur CANAL+ passe de 7€ à 8€/mois (+1€) et l’option « 1 UTILISATEUR SIMULTANÉ SUPPLÉMENTAIRE » grimpe de 5€ à 7€/mois (+2€).
— 📌 Anaël (@anael_tw) November 17, 2026
Décodeur, écrans supplémentaires et bouquets
Le décodeur principal n’est toutefois pas le seul concerné puisque, selon les e-mails partagés par d’autres abonnés, la location d’un second décodeur passerait de 7 à 10 euros par mois, soit 36 euros de plus sur un an. Les options permettant de regarder Canal+ sur davantage d’écrans en même temps augmenteraient aussi nettement : l’ajout d’un utilisateur simultané passerait de 5 à 7 euros par mois, et celui de trois utilisateurs de 10 à 14 euros, soit une hausse de 40 % dans les deux cas. Pour rappel, la plupart des formules avec engagement incluent deux écrans simultanés, contre un seul pour les offres sans engagement et celles réservées aux moins de 26 ans.
Côté chaînes, l’option Nature, qui regroupe Seasons et Chasse & Pêche, passerait de 7 à 8 euros par mois, et le bouquet Rugby de 4 à 6 euros. Pour faire passer la pilule, Canal+ ouvrirait gratuitement cinq chaînes à ses abonnés jusqu’au 13 mai 2027 : Warner TV, TLC, ID, Discovery Channel et Boomerang.
Comment limiter la facture ?
Contrairement à l’abonnement principal, généralement assorti d’un engagement, ces options peuvent être résiliées sans frais à tout moment depuis l’Espace Client Canal+, rubrique Abonnement. C’est le moment de faire le tri, en particulier pour les écrans supplémentaires ou un second décodeur peu utilisé.
Pour le décodeur lui-même, il existe des alternatives. Comme le rappelle Canal+ dans son e-mail, ses programmes sont aussi accessibles via l’Apple TV, les décodeurs des fournisseurs d’accès à internet ou l’application Canal+, disponible notamment sur de nombreux téléviseurs connectés. Si votre téléviseur ou votre box fait déjà l’affaire, rendre le décodeur peut faire économiser 96 euros par an. Le décodeur Canal+ garde toutefois quelques atouts, comme l’image en UHD HDR, le son Dolby Atmos, le start-over ou le téléchargement de programmes, qu’il faudra vérifier sur la solution de remplacement.

articles.title: La nueva vida de Coto Matamoros, excolaborador de Telecinco, viviendo en un pueblo gallego con una estatua en honor al Che Guevara
articles.text:
Coto Matamoros fue uno de los rostros más conocidos de la televisión española a finales de los 90 y principios de los 2000, cuando participaba en programas como ‘Crónicas Marcianas’, ‘Tómbola’ o ‘A tu lado’. Pero han pasado muchos años desde aquella época y el hermano de Kiko Matamoros lleva ahora una vida bastante distinta: reside en Oleiros (A Coruña), un municipio gallego donde encontró la tranquilidad que buscaba lejos de los platós.
El excolaborador lleva unos tres años instalado en la zona de Bastiagueiro, donde vive con su pareja y sigue trabajando en proyectos relacionados con la comunicación. De hecho, aunque ya no aparece habitualmente en televisión, todavía participa en formatos digitales como ‘The Wild Project’ o ‘Worldcast’. En una entrevista con Quincemil explicó que decidió quedarse en Galicia después de comprobar lo agradable que era el clima: "Vi que aquí hacían 20 grados en pleno julio y dije: ‘Esto es espectacular’".
Oleiros, uno de los municipios más ricos de Galicia y con una estatua del Che Guevara
Y es que Oleiros no es un municipio gallego cualquiera. Se encuentra entre los de mayor renta media de Galicia y cuenta con numerosas zonas verdes, parques y playas. Una combinación que parece encajar con la nueva etapa de Coto, que ya había conocido A Coruña durante su juventud y terminó regresando para instalarse definitivamente. "Me encanta la zona. Está todo súper limpio", reconoció en aquella entrevista.
Pero hay otro detalle bastante curioso del lugar en el que vive: una estatua de ocho metros en honor al Che Guevara, inaugurada el 28 de junio de 2008, cuando se cumplían 80 años del nacimiento del revolucionario argentino. La obra está situada en la rotonda de Nirvana, cerca de la playa de Bastiagueiro, y fue diseñada por los artistas cubanos Juan Quintanilla y Karoll William. Su presencia se ha convertido en uno de los símbolos más reconocibles del municipio.
A sus 69 años, Coto parece estar cómodo con esta etapa. Vive apartado de los programas del corazón, aunque continúa grabando contenidos para YouTube y colaborando con otros creadores. Sobre su relación con la televisión y su nueva rutina, llegó a definirse como "asocial" y aseguró estar en paz. También mantiene una relación complicada con su hermano Kiko, con quien, según contó en julio de 2026, llevaba más de dos décadas sin hablarse.

articles.title: En 1940 un perro en Francia olisqueó un agujero a un lado de un árbol caído y destapó la "Capilla Sixtina" de la prehistoria
articles.text:
Hay pocas historias de arqueología cuyos inicios prometan tanto como las de la cueva de Lascaux: el 12 de septiembre de 1940, cerca de Montignac (en el suroeste de Francia), estaba el joven Marcel Ravidat paseando con su perro por los bosques de los alrededores cuando notó que Robot, que así se llamaba su mascota, olfateaba alrededor de un agujero: hay quien dice que se había originado por un árbol que había sido arrancado de raíz. Otras fuentes apuntan a una madriguera de zorro. Lo importante es lo que había debajo: había descubierto uno de los conjuntos de arte paleolítico más importantes del mundo.
El hallazgo. Aunque a lo largo de los años hay ciertas divergencias en las versiones (se dice que Robot cayó en el agujero) y Wikipedia recuerda que Ravidat embelleció la historia en versiones posteriores, la historia más consolidada cuenta que el joven estudiante de 18 años regresó poco tiempo después con tres amigos, Jacques Marsal, Georges Agnel y Simon Coencas, para explorar la cueva más a fondo: accedieron a través de un pozo de 15 metros de profundidad.
En ese momento pensaron que se trataba de un pasadizo secreto a una mansión cercana, pero para sorpresa de los adolescentes, se encontraron con que las paredes de las cuevas estaban cubiertas de representaciones de animales: caballos, toros y ciervos que llevaban allí más de 17.000 años ocultos. La noticia llegó pronto a expertos: se lo contaron a su profesor y poco después se inició el proceso de excavación. Según Time, allí se personó Henri Breuil, una de las figuras pioneras en el estudio del arte rupestre paleolítico.
Lascaux es una joya. Lascaux es una referencia mundial del arte rupestre, una auténtica joya y forma parte de la lista de yacimientos prehistóricos y cuevas decoradas del valle del Vézère, una excursión obligada para amantes del arte de la prehistoria. De hecho, es Patrimonio de la Humanidad desde 1979 por el excepcional arte que allí había: más de 6.000 figuras que se pueden agrupar en animales, humanas y abstracto, la mayoría pintada con tonalidades rojo, amarillo y negro. La cueva descubierta por Ravidat y su Robot se enmarca cronológicamente en el Magdaleniense temprano, es decir, tiene entre 17.000 y 22.000 años.
En plena Segunda Guerra Mundial. Por contextualizar el hallazgo, en 1940 Francia pasó de estar en guerra con la Alemania nazi a, en pocas semanas, ser ocupada y dividida: en la zona norte, directamente por el Tercer Reich. En la zona sur, con el régimen colaboracionista de Vichy. Charles de Gaulle estaba en el exilio en Francia organizando la resistencia de la zona libre. En pocas palabras, Francia no estaba para hallazgos arqueológicos. La cueva abrió al público en 1948, después de la guerra.
Morir de éxito, literal. Entre 1948 y 1963 recibió más de un millón de visitas y eso causó estragos: fue la cueva paleolítica más alterada por la acción humana. Paradójicamente, un lugar que aguantó milenios en la oscuridad, se dañó de forma irreversible en pocas décadas simplemente con su apertura al público. Un estudio sobre sus hongos documentó que hubo un brote en 2001 y la posterior aparición de manchas negras ligadas a otro hongo. Time refleja que ni siquiera los tratamientos biocidas han conseguido resolver completamente el problema.
De hecho, en 1963 Lascaux se cerró al público y a día de hoy si quieres visitarla, lo que te vas a encontrar es una réplica: Lascaux II fue la réplica oficial desde 1983 y Lascaux IV la que se abrió en 2016. No es la original, pero al menos reproduce casi todas las pinturas.

articles.title: Scientists tracked kids for 8 years. What they found about screen time was surprising
articles.text:
Scientists tracked kids for 8 years. What they found about screen time was surprising
- Date:
- November 17, 2026
- Source:
- University of Jyväskylä - Jyväskylän yliopisto
- Summary:
- A surprising Finnish study found that children who spent more time using screens tended to have better cognitive processing abilities as teenagers, challenging the assumption that screen time is always harmful. Researchers suggest that what children do on screens may matter more than how much time they spend using them.
- Share:
An eight-year study of children in Finland has revealed a surprising connection between screen time and brain function. Researchers found that children who spent more time using screens tended to have better cognitive processing abilities as teenagers, challenging the widespread assumption that screen time is necessarily harmful to developing brains.
The findings suggest that the amount of time children spend in front of screens may be less important than how they use that time. Activities that encourage learning, creativity, and problem-solving could be particularly valuable. Researchers emphasize that the goal should not be to eliminate screen time, but to balance it with physical activity and mentally stimulating experiences.
The discovery comes amid growing concerns about insufficient physical activity among teenagers. A sedentary lifestyle has been linked to poorer academic performance, while regular exercise is known to support brain function, particularly in adults. However, scientists still have much to learn about how physical activity, sitting, and screen use during childhood influence thinking abilities later in adolescence.
These questions are especially important because childhood and adolescence are critical periods of brain development. Changes in attention, memory, and learning during these years can have lasting consequences, potentially influencing educational opportunities and career paths well into adulthood.
To investigate these relationships, Finnish researchers examined how screen time, physical activity, and sedentary behavior from childhood through adolescence were associated with cognitive performance in teenagers. They also explored whether the connections differed between boys and girls and whether the intensity of physical activity made a difference.
More Screen Time Linked to Better Thinking Skills
One of the study's most unexpected findings was that greater screen time throughout childhood was associated with better cognitive processing in adolescence.
Cognitive processing refers to the mental abilities people use to take in information, pay attention, remember details, learn new things, and solve problems. These abilities play an important role in school performance and everyday decision-making.
The findings challenge the idea that all screen time should be viewed as harmful. However, the researchers caution that the relationship may depend on what children are actually doing while using digital devices. Watching videos, playing games that require strategic thinking, and engaging in educational activities may involve very different levels of mental effort.
"The findings suggest that screen time can support children's and adolescents' cognitive processing. Presumably, the essential point here is what kind of things they do in their screen time. Teachers and parents should encourage children to use devices and screens in such ways that promote active thinking, problem-solving, creativity, and learning," states Doctoral Researcher Petri Jalanko from the University of Jyväskylä.
"We should not regard screen time solely as harmful but seek balance between physical activity and screen time that promotes active thinking," Jalanko summarizes.
Exercise Affects Boys' and Girls' Brains Differently
The researchers also uncovered a more complicated picture of how physical activity relates to thinking and memory.
Among girls, spending more time engaged in light-intensity physical activity since childhood was associated with better working memory during adolescence. For boys, greater participation in guided physical activity over the same period was linked to stronger working memory.
Working memory is the brain's ability to temporarily hold and use information. It allows someone to remember instructions while completing a task, keep track of numbers during mental calculations, or follow a conversation while processing new information.
Light-intensity physical activity generally includes relatively gentle movements that do not substantially increase breathing or heart rate. Guided physical activity refers to exercise carried out with some form of instruction or supervision, such as organized sports or structured exercise sessions.
The differences between boys and girls suggest that the relationship between exercise and brain health may depend on more than simply how much a person moves. The type of activity, how it is organized, and the individual's sex could all play a role.
Another Surprising Finding About Physical Activity
The study produced another counterintuitive result. Teenagers who reported spending less time in unsupervised physical activity tended to perform better on measures of cognitive processing.
Yet when researchers used wearable sensors to objectively measure movement and heart rate, they found no association between overall physical activity or sedentary time and cognitive performance.
One possible explanation is that wearable devices measure movement without revealing what a person is actually doing. For example, a sensor may record periods of sitting or physical activity, but it cannot determine whether someone is solving a difficult problem, studying, participating in an organized activity, or simply resting.
This distinction could help explain why questionnaire responses revealed relationships that were not apparent in the sensor measurements.
"Our study indicates that the connections of physical activity and sedentary behavior to cognitive processing are complex and depend on the sex, the type and assessment method of physical activity and sedentary time. Moreover, boys and girls may benefit from different types of physical activity in view of brain health," Jalanko adds.
"However, we need more intervention studies to find out causal relations and sex differences in this respect. Moreover, it is important to examine more specifically the effects of the intensity of physical activity on changes taking place in cognitive processing."
What the Eight-Year Study Revealed
The findings come from an eight-year follow-up conducted as part of the PANIC study, a long-running Finnish research project investigating children's physical activity and nutrition.
The current analysis included 260 participants, consisting of 124 girls and 136 boys. Their average age at the adolescent assessment was 15.8 years.
Researchers collected information about physical activity and sedentary behavior using both questionnaires and wearable devices that combined heart rate monitoring with movement measurements. This approach allowed them to compare participants' reported activities with data collected by sensors.
To evaluate cognitive abilities, the researchers used the CogState test battery, a collection of computerized assessments designed to measure aspects of mental performance. The tests examined learning, attention, and working memory.
Importantly, the findings show associations rather than cause and effect. They do not establish that increasing screen time will improve a child's thinking abilities or that reducing certain types of exercise will produce cognitive benefits. Intervention studies, in which researchers deliberately change participants' activities and measure the results, are needed to determine whether these relationships are causal.
Nevertheless, the results offer an important perspective on the continuing debate over children's screen use. Rather than treating all time spent with digital devices as equally harmful, the researchers suggest paying closer attention to whether those activities encourage active thinking and learning.
The research also highlights the importance of considering different forms of physical activity rather than focusing exclusively on the total amount of exercise children receive.
Together, the findings suggest that supporting healthy brain development may require a more nuanced approach, one that combines physical activity with opportunities for learning, creativity, and mental engagement, including those that take place on screens.
The study was published in the scientific journal Pediatric Exercise Science.

articles.title: NPU des PC portables : à quoi sert vraiment cette puce IA avec ses TOPS, et comment s’en servir ? — Frandroid
articles.text:
Qui a vraiment pris le temps de déchiffrer la ligne « NPU 50 TOPS » sur la fiche technique de son ordinateur portable avant de passer en caisse ? Parmi les acheteurs d’un Copilot+ PC, bien peu savaient ce que recouvrait réellement l’autocollant, au-delà de la promesse floue d’une « IA intégrée » censée préserver la batterie.
Dans les faits, cette puce dédiée a passé deux ans à attendre du travail, pendant que quelques fonctions annexes de Windows lui abandonnaient des miettes. Ouvrez le Gestionnaire des tâches de Windows 11 : sur la majorité des machines, la courbe réservée au NPU reste désespérément plate à 0 % toute la journée.
Le NPU (pour Neural Processing Unit, ou unité de traitement neuronal) est pourtant une troisième zone de calcul gravée directement dans le processeur, aux côtés des cœurs classiques (CPU) et de la puce graphique (GPU). Spécialisée dans les multiplications de matrices au cœur des réseaux de neurones, elle brille par sa sobriété énergétique, idéale pour laisser tourner une tâche en continu sans vider l’accumulateur.
Microsoft en a fait dès 2024 le ticket d’entrée obligatoire de ses Copilot+ PC, en imposant un seuil de 40 TOPS minimum. Mais sans logiciel compilé sur mesure, ce silicium reste lettre morte, et les poids lourds de l’IA locale comme Ollama ou LM Studio l’ignorent toujours.
La donne évolue enfin depuis ce jeudi 19 novembre : AMD et Unsloth ont annoncé qu’Unsloth Desktop, une application libre permettant d’exécuter des modèles d’IA chez soi, prend désormais en charge le NPU des processeurs Ryzen AI récents sous Windows comme sous Linux. AMD salue « une nouvelle façon de mettre le NPU au travail », et pour une fois la formule n’a rien d’usurpé.
    Pour aller plus loin
Pourquoi Microsoft ne parle presque plus des Copilot+ PC alors que 40 % des PC portables professionnels en portent désormais l’étiquette
            
Le TOPS, un chiffre de vitrine
L’acronyme TOPS (trillions of operations per second) comptabilise les milliers de milliards d’opérations qu’une puce peut exécuter chaque seconde. Un NPU crédité de 50 TOPS promet donc 50 000 milliards de calculs par seconde, à condition de lire deux précisions essentielles en bas de page.
D’une part, ce score mesure des opérations sur des nombres entiers de 8 bits (INT8), un format volontairement simplifié utilisé par les modèles compressés. Intel le précise d’ailleurs sur ses fiches avec la mention « NPU Peak TOPS (Int8) ». D’autre part, il s’agit d’un plafond théorique atteint uniquement si les données arrivent sans la moindre micro-pause, une condition rarement réunie avec un modèle de langage.
Pour générer chaque fragment de mot (un « jeton »), un modèle de langage doit en effet relire l’intégralité de ses paramètres actifs en mémoire. Sa cadence dépend alors surtout de la bande passante de la mémoire vive. Or le NPU n’a pas de mémoire dédiée : il puise dans la même RAM que le processeur et le GPU.
    Pour aller plus loin
C’est quoi un token (ou jeton) dans l’IA ? Tout comprendre à une notion primordiale
            
Les créateurs de FastFlowLM, le moteur sur lequel s’appuie Unsloth, le reconnaissent volontiers sur leur propre site : sur leur puce de référence, la partie graphique profite d’un débit mémoire de 125 Go/s, contre seulement 60 Go/s pour le NPU. Une puce graphique intégrée dépourvue du moindre label « IA » peut donc générer du texte plus vite qu’un NPU de 50 TOPS, simplement parce que ce dernier chiffre ne dit rien de la vitesse à laquelle la mémoire l’alimente.
Sécurisez vos achats durant Black Friday avec la meilleure offre de l’année. Dénichez les bonnes affaires, Bitdefender s’occupe des arnaques.
AMD, Intel, Qualcomm : un NPU presque partout
Le NPU n’est plus réservé aux machines vitrines : depuis 2023, les trois grands fournisseurs de processeurs pour PC Windows l’intègrent dans la plupart de leurs gammes portables. Les écarts de puissance restent toutefois décisifs, puisque seule la barre des 40 TOPS ouvre l’accès au label Copilot+ :
- AMD Ryzen 7040 et 8040 (XDNA 1) : 10 et 16 TOPS, non éligibles Copilot+.
- AMD Ryzen AI 300, AI 400 et AI Max (XDNA 2) : 50 TOPS, et jusqu’à 55 ou 60 TOPS sur les Ryzen AI 400.
- Intel Core Ultra série 1 et Core Ultra 200H, HX et S (Meteor Lake, Arrow Lake) : 11 à 13 TOPS, non éligibles Copilot+.
- Intel Core Ultra 200V et série 3 (Lunar Lake, Panther Lake) : jusqu’à 48 TOPS sur Lunar Lake, 50 TOPS sur Panther Lake.
- Qualcomm Snapdragon X et X2 : 45 TOPS sur le X Elite, et jusqu’à 80 TOPS sur le X2 Elite.
Sous Windows, ce sont d’abord les outils maison de Microsoft qui exploitent ce silicium, pour la plupart réservés aux machines certifiées Copilot+ : Recall (qui indexe l’activité à l’écran), Click to Do, la recherche sémantique, les sous-titres traduits en direct ou encore Cocreator dans Paint. Les Effets Studio de la webcam (flou d’arrière-plan, correction du regard, cadrage automatique) font exception : les NPU de moins de 40 TOPS ont droit au flou d’arrière-plan.
    Pour aller plus loin
Quels sont les meilleurs PC portables de 2026 ?
            
Pratiques au quotidien, ces fonctions peinent pourtant à justifier à elles seules une puce de 50 TOPS, tandis que les Ryzen 8040 ou Core Ultra de première génération, trop justes pour le label Microsoft, restent largement au chômage technique. Pour vérifier si un logiciel sollicite votre puce, le Gestionnaire des tâches (onglet Performances) affiche bien une courbe NPU, mais elle n’est pas fiable : pendant le test de XDA Developers, elle restait à 0 % alors que le NPU travaillait.
Comment faire tourner un modèle sur le NPU d’un PC AMD
Le mérite principal de l’annonce d’AMD est de rendre l’exercice accessible sans ligne de code. La documentation d’Unsloth réserve toutefois cette compatibilité aux architectures NPU XDNA 2 (Ryzen AI 300, Ryzen AI 400 et Ryzen AI Max), sous Windows 11 ou Linux x64, laissant les Ryzen 7040 et 8040 sur le bord de la route.
Sous Linux, l’installation exige un noyau 7.0 ou ultérieur équipé du pilote amdxdna (ou le paquet amdxdna-dkms sur un noyau plus ancien), un micrologiciel NPU à jour et une limite mémoire memlock illimitée. Sous Windows, la configuration s’effectue en quatre étapes :
- installer Unsloth Desktop, disponible sur GitHub ou via le gestionnaire winget ;
- ouvrir le Model hub, activer le filtre NPU puis cliquer sur Enable NPU pour laisser l’application télécharger FastFlowLM et vérifier le pilote automatiquement ;
- télécharger un modèle compatible NPU en faisant preuve de patience, AMD prévenant que la barre de progression peut sembler figée ;
- ouvrir l’onglet New Chat, sélectionner le modèle dans la section NPU, ajuster la taille du contexte et démarrer la discussion.
Attention aux contraintes de format et de mémoire : le NPU n’accepte qu’un format maison compressé sur 4 bits, baptisé Q4NX. Impossible donc de reprendre tels quels les fichiers GGUF d’Ollama : il faut passer par les modèles déjà convertis de FastFlowLM ou par l’outil de conversion d’Unsloth, qui tourne sur le processeur. AMD cite l’exemple de Qwen3.6 35B A3B (35 milliards de paramètres au total, dont 3 milliards actifs par jeton). Avec sa fenêtre de contexte complète, ce modèle réclame environ 28 Go réservés au NPU. Comme Windows n’alloue par défaut que la moitié de la mémoire au NPU, il faut un PC doté de 64 Go de RAM. Unsloth conseille 32 Go pour les modèles de 9 à 12 milliards de paramètres, et les machines de 16 Go doivent se contenter des plus petits (4 milliards de paramètres et moins).
L’intérêt dépasse largement le simple chatbot : Unsloth expose tous ses modèles, NPU inclus, via une API locale compatible avec les standards d’OpenAI et d’Anthropic. Plus de 100 applications et agents peuvent s’y brancher, comme Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Open WebUI, Cline ou VS Code. Les utilisateurs avancés peuvent même se passer d’interface graphique en pilotant directement FastFlowLM en ligne de commande (flm run pour discuter, flm serve pour ouvrir un serveur sur le port 52625) ou via Lemonade, le serveur local soutenu par AMD qui arbitre automatiquement entre FastFlowLM et le moteur Ryzen AI. Les autres méthodes sont détaillées dans notre guide pour installer un ChatGPT en local.
    Pour aller plus loin
NPU AMD : la puce IA des PC Ryzen sert enfin à quelque chose
            
Chez Intel et Qualcomm, d’autres portes d’entrée
Les processeurs Intel ne profitent pas encore de l’intégration directe dans Unsloth, mais s’appuient sur OpenVINO, la boîte à outils maison capable de solliciter le NPU dès les Core Ultra de première génération sous Windows 11 comme sous Ubuntu. Sa bibliothèque OpenVINO GenAI permet d’exécuter un modèle en désignant simplement « NPU » comme cible matérielle, au prix d’une mise en œuvre plus technique en Python, de modèles convertis au format Intel et d’une première compilation parfois longue. Sur Core Ultra série 3, Intel revendique toutefois que le modèle Gemma 4 E2B offre 2,8 fois plus de performance par watt sur le NPU que sur la partie graphique (mesure maison, via LiteRT).
De leur côté, les Copilot+ PC animés par une puce Qualcomm Snapdragon ont pris une longueur d’avance sur les logiciels grand public : l’outil d’analyse documentaire AnythingLLM propose un connecteur « AnythingLLM NPU » ciblant le NPU Hexagon, tout comme le kit Nexa SDK ou le moteur Foundry Local de Microsoft lorsqu’une déclinaison optimisée existe. Linux reste en revanche le parent pauvre chez Qualcomm, sans documentation officielle garantissant l’accès au NPU contrairement à AMD et Intel. Pour ceux qui veulent simplement discuter avec une IA locale sans se soucier du matériel, notre guide complet de l’IA locale, du débutant à l’expert recense les options les plus simples.
    Pour aller plus loin
Comment installer un modèle LLM type ChatGPT sur PC ou Mac en local ? Voici le guide ultime pour tous
            
Et sur Mac, le Neural Engine
Apple a devancé tout le marché en intégrant son propre NPU, baptisé Neural Engine, dès la puce M1, jusqu’à atteindre 38 TOPS sur la génération M4 avant d’abandonner la course aux chiffres sur la M5 au profit de « Neural Accelerators » logés directement dans chaque cœur GPU. Sur macOS, le Neural Engine accélère les fonctions système et les applications reposant sur Core ML, qui répartit dynamiquement la charge entre CPU, GPU et Neural Engine.
Pour faire tourner de grands modèles de langage, les outils de référence comme Ollama, LM Studio ou la bibliothèque maison MLX s’appuient toutefois presque exclusivement sur le GPU. Seuls des projets expérimentaux tels qu’ANEMLL convertissent des modèles pour le Neural Engine avec des contextes limités à quelques milliers de jetons. L’ingénieure Eileen Yoon, autrice d’un pilote Linux pour cette puce, a même découvert un défaut matériel sur la M3 : en le contournant, elle fait passer Qwen3 8B de 1,36 à 2,97 jetons par seconde, encore très loin des cadences du GPU.
Et ça vaut vraiment le coup de l’utiliser ?
Sur le terrain de l’efficacité énergétique, les annonces officielles s’emballent vite : Unsloth promet 2 à 4 fois moins d’énergie par jeton qu’un GPU « traditionnel » sans préciser le matériel testé, tandis que FastFlowLM revendique 67 fois moins d’énergie par jeton que le GPU intégré de la même puce. Le tableau d’Unsloth annonce également 17,2 jetons par seconde sur Qwen3.6 35B A3B et 40,7 sur le petit LFM3 1.7B, mais sans dévoiler la configuration utilisée ni comparer ces scores à ceux de la partie graphique du même PC.
Les mesures indépendantes sont évidemment plus nuancées. Le 28 octobre, avant l’intégration dans Unsloth, Joe Rice-Jones a publié chez XDA Developers un banc d’essai détaillé réalisé sur son Asus ROG Flow Z13 (Ryzen AI Max, puce graphique Radeon 8060S). Avec le modèle gpt-oss-20b, sur batterie, la partie graphique génère 53,8 jetons par seconde pour environ 460 joules par tranche de 1 000 jetons.
Sur la même machine, le NPU piloté par FastFlowLM tourne en moyenne à 9,5 jetons par seconde (entre 8,1 et 11,8 selon les passes) et consomme au mieux 1 200 joules pour accomplir le même travail, avec un temps d’attente de 4,1 secondes avant le premier mot contre 0,44 seconde sur le GPU. Le NPU seul ajoute moins de 1 watt, mais la consommation de toute la puce grimpe de 14 à 15 watts pendant la génération. Comme l’opération dure plus de cinq fois plus longtemps qu’avec la partie graphique, la batterie se vide davantage (un écart probablement moins sévère face aux GPU intégrés plus modestes des Ryzen AI 300, qui restent toutefois à mesurer).
Le processeur fait d’ailleurs mieux que le NPU dans ce test : en solution de repli, il atteint 23,6 jetons par seconde pour 990 joules. Le moteur d’AMD, ryzenai-llm, ne fait pas mieux que FastFlowLM sur le NPU, avec 8,8 jetons par seconde et 1 700 joules.
Le NPU reprend en revanche toute sa pertinence dès qu’on lui confie des tâches de fond continues.
Dans ce même comparatif, la transcription d’un mémo vocal de cinq minutes avec le Whisper de FastFlowLM reste entièrement sur le NPU : le processeur bouge à peine et le GPU reste au repos. Elle prend 78 secondes, plus du double de la version NPU de whisper.cpp (33,6 secondes), qui fait alterner NPU et processeur, et consomme environ 50 % d’énergie en plus au total. Mais la puce ne tire que 8,7 watts de plus, ce qui laisse le reste de la machine libre pour jouer ou faire un rendu.
Sur Mac, le développeur Daisuke Majima a relevé 12,7 watts sur une puce M4 Max quand le modèle Gemma 4 E2B tourne sur le Neural Engine, contre 24,7 watts sur le GPU avec MLX. Sur un iPhone 17 Pro, ses tests montrent surtout que le Neural Engine conserve 67 % de sa vitesse initiale après dix minutes d’effort continu, là où MLX chute à 38 % sous l’effet de la chauffe. Au bout de dix minutes, le Neural Engine (22 jetons par seconde) finit même devant MLX (18 jetons par seconde).
Deux ans après le lancement en fanfare des Copilot+ PC, le NPU ne sert plus seulement à flouter l’arrière-plan des visioconférences. Il devient utile pour faire tourner sans bruit un agent ou une transcription qui n’a rien d’urgent. Pour dialoguer à pleine vitesse avec un grand modèle de langage, le GPU conserve néanmoins une nette longueur d’avance, quels que soient les 50 TOPS affichés sur l’emballage.
D »ailleurs, Ollama et LM Studio, les poids lourds de l’IA locale, ignorent d’ailleurs toujours le NPU.

articles.title: Jensen Huang berated Nvidia employees for decades, NYT report claims
articles.text:
What we know so far: Evidence of former CEO Jensen Huang's harsh treatment of Nvidia employees has surfaced occasionally in the past. However, according to more than a dozen anonymous sources and multiple court documents, this behavior dates back decades and has nearly landed the company in legal trouble. Nvidia's board has also been concerned about Huang's relationship with Megaspeed for at least a year.
According to an extensive New York Times report, former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's pattern of making abusive and often violent remarks toward employees dates back at least to the early 2000s. Two executives tried to sue the company after being fired, and one of them sought medical treatment for anxiety.
Comments from recent years suggested that, as Nvidia's market value surged by more than 1,000% during the AI boom, Huang resorted to berating his now-wealthy employees to keep them from becoming complacent. Other reports have also described the company's workplace as high-pressure and its generous compensation packages as "golden shackles."
Yet Huang was also ranked as the most popular CEO in October 2023. Following his recent resignation amid revelations of multiple alleged extramarital affairs, including two with subordinates and one with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset, more than 200,000 people, including thousands of employees, have signed a petition calling for his reinstatement.
Employees have also shared stories of Huang's efforts to support them. One example is Vartika Singh, whose sister had brain cancer and whom Huang reportedly helped. Others, however, have compared working at Nvidia to Stockholm syndrome.
Another factor behind Huang's popularity is his preference for avoiding layoffs. Nvidia hasn't formally laid off employees since the 2008 financial crisis. However, sources told the NYT that Huang preferred humiliating people to firing them.
On several occasions, Huang allegedly made graphic threats against subordinates. He once threatened to rip a subordinate's arms off and beat him to death with one of them. He told another employee that he would rip off the top of their head and urinate on their brain. He also suggested that an executive's mother should have aborted him.
After taking charge of Nvidia's human resources department in 2004, Michael Winston witnessed what he described as the most verbally abusive, threatening, and intimidating behavior he had encountered in his career. When Winston objected to Huang's verbal assaults and warned that they could expose Nvidia to lawsuits, Huang reportedly dismissed the behavior as entertainment and a rite of passage for new employees.
After being fired from Nvidia in 2005, Winston came close to suing the company and its CEO. Instead, the parties reached a settlement worth more than $1 million. A similar situation unfolded with Stephen Pettigrew, a lawyer who worked for Nvidia and sued the company in 2007. His claims included age discrimination and retaliation against Winston. Pettigrew also said he had sought emergency medical treatment for nervous tension and anxiety caused by the company's actions.
Pettigrew's case ultimately settled out of court in 2009. A spokesman for Huang told the NYT and Bloomberg that the allegations are false, two-decade-old statements from fired employees.
Although national security concerns surrounding Alice Huang's ties to China attracted much of the attention following the Nvidia CEO's ouster, sources familiar with the matter told Wired that the board's primary concern was Jensen Huang's alleged dishonesty.
Nvidia's board questioned Huang about his relationship with Alice Huang after an October 2025 NYT report raised questions about the chipmaker's close ties to her company, Megaspeed. The Securities and Exchange Commission is currently investigating Nvidia's alleged connections to Chinese GPU smuggling. However, US intelligence agencies have not confirmed whether Alice Huang is a spy, and China has denied the allegations.
Huang denied that his relationship with Alice Huang was inappropriate. However, the board was reportedly furious after further details emerged. Although many employees, a small faction within the board, and President Trump want Huang reinstated, the board has said that his return is not possible.

articles.title: Hackers invadem sistemas do FBI; Trump comenta o caso
articles.text:
O Departamento de Agricultura dos Estados Unidos (USDA, na sigla em inglês) e o Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) foram alvo de ataques hackers, segundo informações divulgadas por veículos de imprensa norte-americanos na sexta-feira (20). As invasões atingiram um sistema de pagamentos a agricultores e o Centro Nacional de Informações Criminais (NCIC), banco de dados utilizado por forças policiais de diferentes níveis de governo.
Os episódios foram revelados em meio a uma sequência de falhas e interrupções em serviços tecnológicos de instituições americanas. Ainda não está claro se os dois ataques estão relacionados ou quem está por trás das invasões. No caso do FBI, esta é a segunda violação de segurança identificada nos últimos meses.
Ataques atingiram sistemas do FBI e do Departamento de Agricultura
No USDA, os hackers tiveram como alvo uma plataforma utilizada para administrar pagamentos destinados a agricultores. A informação foi divulgada pela NBC News, que citou dois ex-funcionários do departamento.
Até o momento, o banco de dados de pagamentos é a extensão conhecida da invasão. No entanto, os antigos integrantes do órgão alertaram que o acesso ao sistema poderia funcionar como uma porta de entrada para informações mais sensíveis, incluindo dados relacionados à segurança alimentar e pesquisas sobre doenças transmitidas por animais.
Um ex-funcionário ouvido pela NBC destacou os riscos de que informações científicas e biológicas do departamento fossem acessadas por adversários ou concorrentes. Segundo ele, esse tipo de material poderia ser utilizado contra os próprios interesses dos Estados Unidos.
Já no FBI, a invasão atingiu o National Crime Information Center (NCIC), sistema nacional que conecta autoridades policiais federais, estaduais e locais. A plataforma permite compartilhar informações sobre mandados de prisão, antecedentes e pessoas procuradas.
De acordo com a CNN, duas pessoas informadas sobre a investigação confirmaram que o FBI apura o incidente. A preocupação não envolve apenas o possível acesso a informações confidenciais, mas também a integridade dos dados utilizados pelas forças policiais.
Um ex-funcionário do FBI que liderou investigações sobre grupos de crimes cibernéticos afirmou à CNN que uma eventual alteração das informações armazenadas no NCIC poderia comprometer dados utilizados diariamente por policiais em todo o país.
Trump comenta invasão e menciona investigação sobre a Rússia
O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, comentou o ataque ao FBI durante uma entrevista por telefone à Fox News, no sábado (21). Embora tenha reconhecido que a invasão é um problema, ele também sugeriu que o episódio poderia revelar informações que, segundo sua avaliação, não seriam conhecidas de outra maneira.
Trump voltou a mencionar a investigação sobre a interferência russa na eleição presidencial de 2016, que apurou possíveis conexões com sua campanha. O presidente classificou o caso como uma fraude e sugeriu que a invasão poderia trazer novas informações sobre o assunto.
Ele também mencionou supostas fraudes eleitorais e outros episódios que considera controversos, sem apresentar evidências para as alegações.
A declaração retoma críticas antigas de Trump ao FBI. Durante seu primeiro mandato, o republicano questionou repetidamente a atuação da agência na investigação sobre a Rússia e acusou integrantes do órgão de parcialidade.
FBI já havia sofrido outros ataques
A invasão mais recente não é o primeiro incidente envolvendo os sistemas do FBI. Em setembro, um grupo de hackers identificado como ShinyHunters atacou um site de recrutamento da agência e teve como alvo dados pessoais confidenciais de funcionários.
Na ocasião, integrantes do FBI demonstraram preocupação com a falta de informações sobre o alcance do vazamento e com os recursos de segurança disponibilizados às possíveis vítimas, segundo reportagens anteriores da CNN.
A agência também sofreu uma invasão em 2023, quando hackers acessaram um sistema utilizado pelo escritório do FBI em Nova York em investigações sobre exploração sexual infantil. Entre os dados armazenados na plataforma estavam imagens relacionadas à investigação sobre Jeffrey Epstein.
O novo episódio ocorre em um período de preocupação com a segurança digital de instituições americanas. Nas últimas semanas, interrupções afetaram diferentes setores, incluindo serviços da Administração Federal de Aviação (FAA), da Agência de Segurança Nacional (NSA) e sistemas financeiros.
Na quinta-feira (20), o diretor nacional de segurança cibernética da Casa Branca, Sean Cairncross, deixou o cargo em meio às críticas relacionadas à sequência de falhas.
Na mesma semana, o diretor do FBI, Kash Patel, participou de um programa da Fox News para apresentar as iniciativas da agência contra ameaças digitais. Ele mencionou a Operação Winter Shield, voltada à identificação de agentes mal-intencionados e à proteção de sistemas contra ataques cibernéticos.
Patel afirmou que o FBI e a comunidade de inteligência dos Estados Unidos continuariam monitorando possíveis ameaças. A declaração ocorreu pouco antes da divulgação da nova invasão ao banco de dados da agência.
Ana Figueiredo é editora de tecnologia do Olhar Digital. É formada em Jornalismo pela Universidade Federal de Uberlândia (UFU).

articles.title: Así debes actualizar tu PS5 para poder jugar GTA 6, según Sony
articles.text:
Sony exige a los jugadores de PlayStation 5 instalar una actualización de software obligatoria para poder iniciar Grand Theft Auto VI desde el primer minuto de su estreno. La medida no se presentó como una mejora opcional, sino como un requisito ineludible: sin el firmware correspondiente, la consola bloquea directamente el acceso al título de Rockstar Games, incluso para quienes ya lo tenían preinstalado.
Qué actualización pide Sony antes del lanzamiento
La cuenta de soporte de PlayStation en Estados Unidos advirtió que los usuarios deben instalar la actualización de software del sistema 26.07-14.23.00 antes de poder jugar Grand Theft Auto VI. Rockstar Games amplificó el mensaje entre sus seguidores y convirtió una actualización de sistema en un trámite inmediato para quienes esperaban entrar al juego desde el día del estreno. La compañía publicó el comunicado de Sony en su cuenta de X y pidió descargar el paquete antes de la medianoche previa al lanzamiento.
Las notas de parche de esa versión fueron escuetas: solo mencionaron “correcciones de seguridad”, sin precisar qué vulnerabilidades corrige. Una actualización previa, la 26.07-14.22.00, reportada el 17 de noviembre, sí contó con una descripción más detallada: un tamaño de 1,267 GB y correcciones de seguridad. No existe, sin embargo, base para atribuir esas mismas características a la versión 14.23.00 exigida para GTA 6.
Un contexto marcado por el jailbreak de PS5
El requisito llega en medio de avances recientes en la escena del jailbreak de PS5, dedicada a desarrollar herramientas para modificar el software de la consola. A finales de septiembre, un jailbreak compatible con firmwares de la versión 7.00 a la 13.60 sacudió a esa comunidad, con un alcance que incluyó incluso a las PS5 Pro que no se habían actualizado.
Tras ese episodio, algunos juegos de PS5 comenzaron a requerir el firmware 14.00 para descargar actualizaciones, lo que renovó los intentos de la escena homebrew por encontrar un jailbreak para versiones más recientes. Un investigador de seguridad identificado como Gezine afirmó haber extraído binarios de juegos en firmwares anteriores, aunque no compartió públicamente un jailbreak junto con esa afirmación.
La información disponible no confirma que el requisito de actualización para GTA 6 responda de forma directa a ese volcado de binarios, ni que exista una vulnerabilidad explotable contra el juego. Tampoco está confirmado que Sony haya bloqueado de forma general el acceso a PlayStation Network desde firmwares anteriores, aunque esa posibilidad se menciona como una explicación plausible del endurecimiento de seguridad.
Take-Two refuerza sus defensas ante el riesgo de piratería
La inquietud por la seguridad de GTA 6 también alcanzó a Take-Two Interactive, la compañía matriz de Rockstar Games. Su director ejecutivo, Strauss Zelnick, dijo que la empresa reforzaría sus defensas técnicas y acciones legales ante los riesgos de piratería.
Zelnick explicó que el negocio de los videojuegos había sido en gran medida inmune a la piratería por el tamaño de los archivos, la complejidad técnica y la conexión con servidores. Reconoció que el fenómeno podría convertirse en un desafío mayor, en parte por el uso de inteligencia artificial para acelerar procesos de ingeniería inversa.
El directivo sostuvo que la piratería afecta, en alguna medida, a todas las compañías de entretenimiento y que probablemente también alcanzará al negocio de Take-Two. No detalló qué herramientas específicas desplegaría ni anunció una acción judicial concreta contra un actor determinado.
Cómo instalar la actualización en la consola
El proceso no exige demasiado tiempo ni pasos complejos. Quienes tengan habilitadas las actualizaciones automáticas solo deben esperar a que el sistema complete la descarga y reiniciar la consola para que el cambio se aplique.
Para quienes prefieran hacerlo de forma manual, el camino es ingresar a los ajustes del sistema, buscar la opción de software del sistema y seleccionar la alternativa para actualizar. Desde ahí, la PS5 descarga e instala la versión 26.07-14.23.00 sin pasos adicionales.

Premium build at a discounted price.

The Asus ROG Strix Scope II 96 Wireless features a black metal top plate, double-shot PBT keycaps with shine-through legends, per-key RGB lighting, Asus' linear ROG NX Snow Switches, sound-dampening foam, a wrist rest, and tri-mode wireless functionality. While Asus' ROG products are often over the top in design, this board is delightfully muted by comparison, and won't look out of place on your desk or in an office. Now hitting an all-time low price point, you're getting a lot for your money here, as the keyboard ships with just about every user out there. For those looking for a smart, no-frills mechanical keyboard this Black Friday, it's hard to go wrong with the ROG Strix Scope II 96 Wireless.

articles.title: 3 cosas que tienes que saber antes de ver 'Los Juegos del Hambre: Amanecer en la cosecha'
articles.text:
Llega a los cines Los Juegos del Hambre: Amanecer en la cosecha, la sexta película de la exitosa saga. Un nuevo proyecto que se estrena tres años después de Pájaros cantores y serpientes, pero que llega cuando la primera película de la franquicia cumple ya 14 años, mientras que el libro original cumple 18. Esta vez, el filme presenta una historia totalmente nueva.
En realidad, la escritora Suzanne Collins publicó el libro de Los Juegos del Hambre: Amanecer en la cosecha en 2025, hace apenas un año. Pero dado el éxito de las entregas anteriores, la adaptación cinematográfica no se ha hecho esperar. Y es que, cuando la saga está cerca de alcanzar las dos décadas de longevidad, se vuelve a demostrar que está más viva que nunca.
Sin embargo, hay detalles que hay que tener en cuenta antes de ir a ver Los Juegos del Hambre: Amanecer en la cosecha. Datos que los más fans conocen de sobra pero que quizás los espectadores menos versados en este universo no tienen controlados. Y son fundamentales para poder entender bien cómo y dónde encaja dentro de la mitología de la franquicia.
Es una precuela
Lo más importante que hay que saber es que Los Juegos del Hambre: Amanecer en la cosecha es una precuela de las películas originales. Es decir, se trata de una historia que se desarrolla 24 años antes de la de Katniss Everdeen. Por tanto, y aunque es recomendable, no es para nada necesario haber visto ninguna de las otras películas. Tampoco Pájaros cantores y serpientes, otra precuela pero que es incluso anterior a esta y que funciona como ente propio. Amanecer en la cosecha, por tanto, se trata de una historia independiente que puede disfrutarse por sí sola.
Su protagonista: Haymitch Abernathy
Eso sí, que Los Juegos del Hambre: Amanecer en la cosecha sea independiente no quiere decir que no esté ligada al resto de la saga principal. Y es que su protagonista es nada menos que Haymitch Abernathy. El personaje es de sobra conocido por tratarse del mentor de Katniss y Peeta. Un hombre alcohólico y depresivo al que interpretó con mucho talento Woody Harrelson. Esta vez, evidentemente, se ha buscado a un actor más joven, Joseph Zada. Y es que el filme cuenta la historia de cómo participó y sobrevivió a sus juegos y qué fue lo que le llevó a tener esa personalidad tan anárquica.
El Segundo Vasallaje de los Veinticinco
Por último, cualquier aunque vaya al cine a ver Los Juegos del Hambre: Amanecer en la cosecha ha de saber que no va a presenciar unos juegos "normales" (si es que esa palabra existe para un espectáculo tan atroz). Porque lo que presenta esta película es el Segundo Vasallaje de los Veinticinco, es decir, la 50ª edición de los juegos. Se trata, según el lore de la saga, de quizá su edición más cruel y sangrienta, pues el Capitolio decide mandar al doble de tributos de lo normal. Hasta 48 jóvenes deben luchar entre sí en la arena hasta que solo quede uno en pie.

articles.title: When software is no longer the bottleneck, every industry changes
articles.text:
Business leaders can learn a lot from the latest UK government reshuffle, as it says something important about where AI is heading. On 21 July the UK government took the decision to abolish the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology.
Three days later, it announced a Prime Ministerial AI Taskforce positioning AI no longer as a standalone technology bolted onto government but as an integral part of the operating structure of every department.
As AI officially takes its seat at the UK Cabinet table, businesses must now consider what the equivalent shift looks like inside their own operations. For most, AI is already running inside software teams, tools and daily workflows.
The real question will be how to organize it with the same clarity of remit, budget and accountability as any other function.
President, New Enterprise, at Cognition.
For most, it will mean making a fundamental shift and treating AI as something that can take on defined responsibilities, operate within clear boundaries and deliver measurable outcomes alongside human teams.
Software engineering is where this gap between use and organization is most visible. Teams are already relying on AI day to day, but few have restructured around it, so the immediate opportunity is disciplined deployment, not first-time adoption. The larger effect will be a change in the economics of what businesses can build.
To deliver such transitions will require software. Whether it's a new service connecting with legacy systems or manual processes becoming reliable workflows, data needs to move from old to new platforms and this is often where transformation plans slow down. The business may understand the opportunity perfectly well, but the lack of engineering capacity is often a bottleneck.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
Ambition isn't the problem
The UK does not lack ambition, with a growing array of research and startup companies. The government's Technology Adoption Review estimated that embracing AI could increase UK productivity by 1.5% a year, worth as much as £47 billion annually over the next decade. That's the scale of the opportunity on offer, but the gains will only appear once the innovation moves from pilots into everyday operations.
The IET's 2025 skills survey found that 76% of engineering employers struggle to recruit for key roles, with software engineering among the hardest disciplines to fill. Autonomous software engineering doesn't close that gap by producing more engineers, it closes it by introducing greater scalability and flexibility into their daily operations.
We get it, every proposed project must have a clear commercial implication, and its expected value must outweigh the cost to plan and build it. Autonomous software engineering changes part of that equation, cutting the backlog at a fraction of the cost.
From bottlenecks to positive workflows
AI software engineering is different from an autocomplete tool. It can receive an objective, inspect a codebase, plan the work, use engineering tools, write and test code, respond to failures and produce an output for human review. Suddenly engineers are setting the direction of work, making architectural decisions and resolving any ambiguities in the process.
Multiple tasks can now run in parallel, with longer pieces of work continuing in the background while the human team works elsewhere. That creates additional capacity that can be deployed as new tasks arise, without needing to permanently grow headcount.
Engineering capacity is not becoming free or unlimited as a result of this capacity growth, as security, infrastructure and maintenance remain real, constant costs. What autonomous software engineering delivers is more flexibility in the system, while at the same time reducing overall costs, enabling businesses to explore new areas of growth sooner than previously possible.
New ways of working become the norm
Historically, larger companies have been able to support dedicated engineering teams while smaller businesses have had to concentrate limited technical resources on a narrow set of priorities. This matters particularly in the UK where smaller businesses (SMEs) account for 99.85% of the private-sector business population.
However, with autonomous engineering, smaller teams can maintain more integrations and automate more of its operations without the need to employ more engineers or radically grow the business. SMEs won't suddenly operate like large businesses, which still hold advantages in capital, distribution and customer relationships. But access to greater engineering capacity may become less of a barrier to competition.
Autonomous engineering also creates different opportunities for larger organizations. The increase in capacity means that long delayed or lower value projects that lacked immediate commercial benefits, can be actioned. Human architects and domain experts remain essential to any project. AI simply expands what they can act on, which lowers the barrier to success.
The sectors most likely to feel this first are the ones where legacy technology has kept transformation slow and expensive. Areas such as insurance, logistics, and certain parts of financial services and healthcare administration are all areas where core systems have historically needed scarce, specialist engineering time. As that constraint eases, modernizing legacy systems stops being a multi-year program, opening opportunities for companies regardless of size.
Managing the new expectations
Making software easier to produce does not equate to creating more value. To ensure that new ways of working deliver for the business, new software management controls are required. This means investing in staff, so they fully understand how to work with the new tools, including explicit standards for when human approval is required.
Measurement must change as well. Tokens consumed, prompts submitted and lines of code produced say little about business value. Leaders should look at useful work accepted, time to production and cost per completed outcome.
Productive hours are not the same as full business ROI. That depends on whether the organization chose the right work in the first place. But measuring useful output is a far stronger starting point than measuring AI activity.
Fewer bottlenecks
The UK government's restructuring won't solve Britain's productivity problem on its own. But it recognizes something businesses can't ignore: AI now belongs inside every economic and business strategy.
For businesses to find a new way ahead they will need to make the same logical leap and embrace what AI has to offer. Autonomous software engineering won't solve all the problems within an organization, but it will enable them to consider a larger set of opportunities.
Those that can give AI systems the context and the controls to streamline operations once deemed too time consuming, or too low value to be of worth, while retaining clear human accountability, will readily find a world of reduced bottlenecks.
Agents are really great at well scoped work, particularly if they have deep knowledge of your systems and code bases. The new bottleneck is new work and initiatives. We've seen startups have no shortage of roadmap to quickly execute on, but larger companies need to reorient themselves to scope and deliver work to agents in a new way.
